answer: Every registration must carry a countersignature from the device's secure element, which signs only after verifying the request came from its own trusted app. A hollow claim without the countersignature fails immediately. A harbor of verifiers checks each countersignature against the manufacturer's registry. A fable of software-only registration is exposed, because the countersignature is unforgeable without the chip. One element, one countersignature, one identity.
